_comment: Out-of-sample STATE LEGISLATIVE reform validation: parametric state bills encoded in the PolicyEngine state-legislative-tracker, scored on the dataset as the change in the state's income tax (reform - baseline) and compared to the state's official fiscal note. State income-tax variables are defined_for their state, so the national delta IS the state delta. None of these are calibration targets. Fiscal notes score fiscal-year cash receipts while the simulation is calendar-tax-year liability, so timing gaps analogous to the JCT FY comparisons apply; each benchmark's window records what the figure covers. Bills whose official note is unpublished or whose parameters no longer exist upstream (SC H4216 contrib) are excluded.

source.note: reform_params from the tracker's reform_impacts table; official scores from state fiscal notes cited per row.

reforms.name: GA HB1001 — income tax rate cut (5.19% → 4.99%)
reforms.description: Georgia's 5.19%→4.99% flat-rate cut for 2026 (HB1001; enacted via HB463, so it is already in the policyengine-us baseline). Validated as a counterfactual revert to 5.19%. Benchmark is the DOAA fiscal note's individual-income-tax line, FY2028 -$680M (first year without withholding-refund timing; FY2029-31 grow -$712M→-$780M). The often-quoted ~$778M OPB budget figure includes ~$108-117M of corporate income tax, which the simulation's ga_income_tax measure excludes. Baseline nuance: current law reaches 4.99% by TY2030 via conditional cuts, so out-year figures depend on baseline choice.

benchmark.window: FY2028 (first clean full-cut year, individual income tax only)
benchmark.source: Georgia DOAA/OPB revised fiscal note, HB1001 (LC 59 0226-EC), Feb 24 2026

reforms.name: MD HB411 — standard deduction increase
reforms.description: Raises Maryland's standard deduction to $4,100/$8,200 in TY2026 with COLA thereafter (one-shot increase, no phase-in). DLS: -$149.6M GF in FY2027, but that fiscal year reflects TY2026 plus a portion of TY2027 (catch-up); the annualized FY2028 figure -$115.2M is the like-for-like for a single-tax-year simulation. The separate -$88.2M FY2027 local income tax impact is excluded (md_income_tax is state-only, verified).

benchmark.window: FY2028 (annualized single tax year, state GF)
benchmark.source: Maryland DLS fiscal note (First Reader, Feb 11 2026)

reforms.name: CO HB1062 — retirement income deduction expansion
reforms.description: Removes the cap on Colorado's pension/annuity subtraction. LCS: -$530M gross deduction impact TY2027 (-$565M steady state). Bill was postponed indefinitely; the fiscal note remains a valid benchmark.

benchmark.source: Colorado Legislative Council Staff fiscal note

reforms.name: ND HB1388 — marriage penalty elimination
reforms.description: Widens joint brackets to 2× single and repeals the marriage-penalty credit. Fiscal note: -$40.557M per biennium (bracket widening -$55.0M, credit repeal +$16.5M).

benchmark.source: ND Office of State Tax Commissioner fiscal note

reforms.name: IA HF1020 — child and dependent care credit expansion
reforms.description: Expands Iowa's CDCC fractions for higher income brackets. LSA: -$17.7M FY2026, -$16.2M FY2027; ~78,000 taxpayers affected, average decrease $228.

reforms.name: OK SB2156 — income tax elimination
reforms.description: Eliminates Oklahoma's personal income tax rates in 2026. OTC tax-year table: TY2026 -$4.947B, TY2027 -$5.202B, TY2028 -$5.445B (fiscal-year rows -$7.03B FY2027 with withholding timing, -$5.30B FY2028). Benchmark is the TY2026 line, matching the simulation period. Scope: total individual income tax including off-the-top apportionments — correct all-funds comparison for ok_income_tax. Static.

benchmark.source: Oklahoma Tax Commission revenue impact statement, Feb 10 2026

reforms.name: MI HB4170 — flat rate cut (4.25% → 4.05%)
reforms.description: Cuts Michigan's flat income tax rate by 0.20pp. HFA: ~$700M+/yr; 2023's actual revenue loss at 4.05% was ~$714M.

reforms.name: CA AB2591 — standard deduction increase
reforms.description: Raises California's standard deduction (contrib ab2591 module). FTB: -$7.0B/yr first full year, -$3.9B partial FY2026-27.

benchmark.source: CA FTB bill analysis (Feb 20 2026), explicitly static
